Chapter 194: Good Brothers for Life

The small supermarket in the dormitory area was in an excellent location, right on the path students from Fuyi High School had to take back to their dorms after school.

Boss Liu of the small supermarket had only managed to secure such a location because of his family connection to the vice-principal.

It was because the connection was a bit distant that he failed to beat out the owner of the shop next to the school cafeteria, so he had settled for this small supermarket as the next best thing.

Compared to the one by the school cafeteria, although the supermarket in the dormitory area also had decent foot traffic, it only had customers during two time slots: morning and evening.

But thanks to its monopoly, it still made a considerable profit each month.

After deducting the rent paid to the school and labor costs, the net monthly income could reach twenty to thirty thousand yuan, which was definitely a nice side business.

Boss Liu's family was in the supply business, so he could get the supermarket's goods at an even lower price, creating a large profit margin.

Now over fifty, Boss Liu was in a semi-retired state. After handing over the family business to his son, he enjoyed coming here every day for a stroll.

Watching the vibrant, youthful students stream in and out of his supermarket, a gentle smile would appear on his face.

Sometimes, when he was in a good mood, he would even give a few students a popsicle or something, which in turn gave the small supermarket a very good reputation among the student body.

And the scene Boss Liu now loved to watch most was squatting by the supermarket after the evening self-study bell at Fuyi High School rang, watching the students sprint in from outside the dormitory area gate.

To avoid wasting time queuing at the supermarket, many boys had already made ample preparations in their classrooms before the bell even rang.

If they were on a higher floor, some would even pretend to go to the restroom in advance, only to sneak down to a restroom on the first floor and wait.

The moment the bell rang, they would bolt out like crazed wild dogs.

You never saw them try this hard at the school sports meet, but when it came to trivial matters like this, each one was better than the next at unlocking their potential.

It had to be said that running like this often was actually quite good for their physical fitness.

And it was this group of boys who, every time, managed to appear at the supermarket entrance within just a few dozen seconds, leaping past Boss Liu one by one, which made him exceptionally happy to watch.

Generally speaking, the boys who ran at the very front were basically buying instant noodles, plus a sausage, and some would add a marinated egg and a small snack.

This combo would cost seven or eight yuan; more expensive instant noodles could cost over ten yuan.

However.

In recent days, Boss Liu had noticed something unusual.

Previously, every single one of these boys who ran at the front of the pack would dash into his small supermarket.

But starting from Monday this week, there would always be one or two boys who, despite being at the front, wouldn't enter the supermarket and would instead run directly toward the dormitory building.

The number was small at first, and Boss Liu didn't pay it much mind, assuming they were just in a hurry to get back to their dorms to shower or secretly play on their phones.

But as time went on, by Wednesday and Thursday, nearly half of the ten or twenty boys sprinting at the front from the school's direction were heading straight for the back of the boys' dormitory building.

This made Boss Liu quite puzzled.

What was up with these boys?

Behind the boys' dormitory building, wasn't that just the girls' dormitory building?

With this thought, Boss Liu, his face full of suspicion, watched on Friday night as more than twenty figures sprinted madly towards the back of the boys' dormitory building, none showing any intention of entering his supermarket. This finally made him unable to sit still.

Although this matter didn't have a major impact on his supermarket, as the vast majority of students would still come in to buy things.

But not figuring out what was happening left him feeling a little uneasy.

So he stood up, and following the direction the boys had just sprinted, he walked around the boys' dormitory building with a puzzled expression.

Then, he immediately saw a queue formed in front of the fire escape gate.

Each person held cash, exchanging money for goods, completing the transaction with two boys outside the iron gate.

Boss Liu walked closer for a look and raised his eyebrows in surprise. "Egg fried rice?"

The twenty boxes of egg fried rice sold out quickly, the transactions completed in just a minute or two.

The boys who got the egg fried rice were all elated, looking like victorious soldiers returning home as they happily went back to their dorms.

But there were also students who were ranked beyond the twentieth spot. Seeing that they didn't manage to get one, they immediately gripped the bars of the iron gate and pleaded miserably, "Bro! Don't you still have a few portions left? Can you sell me one? I'm begging you, bro!"

"Um..." Li Luo glanced at the number "2013" engraved on this brother's school uniform, clearly an upperclassman from the second year, and said with some embarrassment, "Upperclassman, you should know, right? We only sell twenty portions a day, no more. The rest are reserved for our own friends."

Hearing this, the upperclassman became even more anxious. He quickly stopped a few students who had bought fried rice and hadn't walked far, asking if they would sell him a portion at a higher price.

But his luck wasn't very good; no one was willing to sell to him.

And not long after.

Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang came over, smiling, and took their free fried rice from Li Luo.

That student didn't spare them either, but Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang also refused. They said goodbye to Li Luo and headed back to their dorm.

It wasn't until Yan Zhusheng and Xu Yinghuan walked up to the iron gate together that the student finally directed his plea to them. "I promised the girl I like that I'd get her the egg fried rice from here today. Please, I'm begging you, could you sell me one box? I can pay extra, is twenty yuan okay?"

Yan Zhusheng blinked, looking at the upperclassman, then turned her head to look at Li Luo, and tilted her head.

Li Luo shrugged indifferently, indicating that it was up to her.

So Yan Zhusheng nodded, handed over the egg fried rice in her hand, and said very seriously, "Twenty yuan, you said it."

"Yes, yes, yes! Here's twenty!" The upperclassman was almost crying with joy. He quickly pulled two ten-yuan bills from his pants pocket, stuffed them into Yan Zhusheng's hand, then immediately grabbed the egg fried rice and sprinted away, not forgetting to turn his head and shout as he ran, "Thank you!"

Yan Zhusheng looked down at the twenty yuan in her hand, turned back to the iron gate, and held it out to Li Luo. "Here."

"Why are you giving it to me? It's your money, you should keep it," Li Luo said with a laugh. The corner of his eye had already caught sight of Boss Liu nearby, so he continued, "Go buy some snacks at the supermarket. Eating egg fried rice all the time can get boring."

"I'll split it with you then." Yan Zhusheng took back one ten-yuan bill and stuffed the other into Li Luo's hand. "You go buy some snacks too."

"Alright then, I won't be polite." Li Luo accepted Yan Zhusheng's ten yuan, treating it as having sold one extra box meal tonight. "You two should head back and eat it soon, it won't taste good when it's cold."

"Okay, bye-bye, Class Rep," Xu Yinghuan replied, pulling Yan Zhusheng along. "I'll give you half of mine."

Watching Yan Zhusheng and the other girl leave, after Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun distributed the remaining egg fried rice to a few acquaintances, Boss Liu, who was standing nearby, could no longer hold back. He walked up to the iron gate and asked, "You two students, judging by your school uniforms, you're from Fuyi High School, right?"

"Yeah," Li Luo nodded.

"Do your parents know you're out here selling egg fried rice?" Boss Liu said. "It's a bit dangerous to be out so late. You should stop doing this in the future."

"Don't worry, uncle, we have an elder with us," Li Luo said, pointing to Lin Xiufeng's figure by the roadside. "We just wanted to experience what a work-study program feels like, so we're trying to sell egg fried rice. We only sell twenty portions a day."

Hearing him put it that way, Boss Liu felt it wouldn't be right to give the students too hard a time.

So he just nodded, having gotten a sense of the situation, chatted for a few more sentences, and then took his leave.

In Boss Liu's view, Li Luo's egg fried rice business didn't have much of an impact on his supermarket.

After all, the egg fried rice only brought in two hundred yuan in revenue each day, and since it was students just trying it out for the experience, they would probably stop soon enough.

So Boss Liu didn't bother with it any further.

Besides, with the New Year gradually approaching, the family business was getting busy. Although he was retired, Boss Liu still worried about his son.

Thus, after confirming there were no major issues with his small business at Fuyi High School, he turned his attention back home to check on the big business.

After watching Boss Liu leave, Li Luo also breathed a small sigh of relief.

After all, if the man had really called security, it would have been a bit troublesome.

However...

"Let's count it up, how much is it?"

Li Luo asked Zhao Rongjun beside him.

"I got 64 yuan today, too." Zhao Rongjun excitedly pulled out the money he had saved over the past few days from his pocket and counted it carefully. "In total, it's 320 yuan! Plus the pocket money I saved before, I have 350 now!"

"Let's do this then." Li Luo took out an extra fifty yuan from today's earnings and slapped it into Zhao Rongjun's hand. "This should make it an even four hundred yuan. Go buy your grandparents a down jacket. I'm exhausted after working for a week, so we're not doing this next week."

"Huh?" Hearing they were stopping, Zhao Rongjun was stunned for a moment, then quickly said, "I think we can keep going. We're only busy for less than an hour and can make fifty or sixty yuan. Won't that be over a thousand a month? I don't even get that much for my living allowance."

Li Luo looked at Zhao Rongjun in surprise. Seeing the serious look on the boy's face, he didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

It had to be said, making money was indeed quite addictive.

Especially for a young person who had never earned money before. Experiencing the taste of earning money for the first time, full of energy, they might not even feel tired and might even enjoy it.

This left Li Luo a bit exasperated.

"You should take a break. There's nowhere to sell this weekend anyway. If you really want to sell, wait until next week," Li Luo shook his head helplessly. "Let's go buy the clothes this week first."

"Alright then." Zhao Rongjun stroked the fire escape gate a bit reluctantly, looking like he was really getting into it.

However, after getting on the electric tricycle, Zhao Rongjun gave Li Luo a very solemn reminder: "Don't ask Ying Chanxi and the others to come along when we go buy the clothes."

"Huh?"

"What do you mean, 'huh'?"

"I didn't invite them, but Xixi and the others have already made plans..." Li Luo scratched his head. "They all know you're buying down jackets for your grandparents, so they've arranged to go together and do some shopping."

Zhao Rongjun's face darkened. "...Then why don't you go with them? I can just go buy the down jackets by myself."

"How could I do that?" Li Luo grinned and wrapped an arm around Zhao Rongjun's neck. "Good brothers, for life. I'll definitely go with you."

(End of Chapter)
